method: Legacy fixed, two players, 143 tokens / 48 lights / 28 wall pieces. Snap trials compare assistance on/off at 1x/20x; assisted smooth runs are supplemental. Snap is forced only by a test-only capability override, with no user-facing animation toggle. New disposable server and campaign per run. Both clients settle before the next move and before ending the CPU window. No video, CPU profiler, Playwright tracing or phase timing. GPU/accelerated Canvas2D disabled and WebGL blocked.
